provenance.dimension_basis: ACP AMSO specification 20271801, US customary dimensions; AMSO22/35 share exterior envelope; power variant not resolved visually
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

review.method: Actual final compressed input/output boards inspected at every retained shot start/middle/end, plus detailed changed-action/readout sequences. Original source frames inspected densely around affected mechanics and scope boundaries. Native geometry diagnostics and editable timeline synchronized.
observations: Preserve source-specific nativev007 model and tracked camera. Correct Ready display through872, Enter Program starts873 after dense source review.
Retain visible principal intro, cavity and programming shots including weak transition boundary frames. Unresolved membrane travel is not invented.
limitations: Manufacturer nominal AMSO family envelope/cavity; exact power/revision suffix remains unresolved. Hidden hinge/latch sizes and local print details are inferred.
Source people, food, titles, wipes and fades are omitted under the selected microwave structure, visible mechanisms and camera scope. First/last weak principal outlines remain retained.
Camera focal depth and hidden/intermediate motion are estimated from visible features; macro perspective and source readout font appearance remain approximate.

Static native states use exact projection-equivalent camera-frustum caches verified on27 noncoplanar points for every retained frame; moving states are rendered natively. This validates cache projection, not a claim of pixel-perfect source reconstruction.
Manifold/recess and sampled door-surface clearance checks are kinematic diagnostics. No force/contact/interlock/cooking simulation was performed.

source_specific_revision.revision: Preserve source-specific nativev007 model and tracked camera. Correct Ready display through872, Enter Program starts873 after dense source review.
